name: Schedules-Direct-XMLTV
description: Schedules Direct XMLTV automatically downloads TV guide data from Schedules Direct, converts it to XMLTV format, refreshes the guide on a schedule, and serves the resulting tvxml.xml file over HTTP. Designed for use with Threadfin, Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, TVHeadend, and other applications that accept an XMLTV guide URL. Supports first-run setup mode so a lineup ID does not need to be known before installation. Supports both amd64 and arm64 Docker hosts.

paths.name: XMLTV Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for generated XMLTV data and Schedules Direct configuration.

ports.name: XMLTV HTTP Port
ports.description: Host port used to serve the generated tvxml.xml file.

variables.name: Schedules Direct Lineups
variables.description: Optional comma-separated Schedules Direct lineup IDs. Leave blank during initial setup if you do not know your lineup ID yet. After the container starts, use the SD-JSON configuration wizard to discover or add a lineup. Example: USA-OTA-10001

variables.name: Guide Days
variables.description: Number of days of guide data to download during each synchronization.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by the container and the scheduled midnight guide refresh.
